question: What supreme attainment makes one dear to the yoginis?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation are named together.
Great accomplishment is the stated attainment.
This attainment brings favor with the yoginis.
inference: One who attains the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation becomes dear to the yoginis.
plain_english: He may become dear to the yoginis through the great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation.
